title: Stephanie Farrar
description: Farrar decried legislation that would ban puberty blockers from being given to children.
body:
# Stephanie Farrar

# Board Clerk/Governance Officer

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/farrar-profile.jpg)

- In Dec. 2025, Farrar **[promoted](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/2de549b1-214c-4eeb-8d00-331e3ff4f4b3/WI-Eau-Claire-Farrar-Black-Interest.png)** a “Black PTA Interest Meeting” and invited only Black teachers, staff and parents of Black or biracial children.
- Farrar **[decried legislation](https://pbswisconsin.org/news-item/misinformation-flowed-at-wisconsin-assembly-transgender-bills-hearing-here-are-facts-on-gender-affirming-care-and-trans-athletes/)** that would ban puberty blockers from being given to children.
- Said she is **[committed to](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/97948d6c-c7d1-474a-b69d-75d6c5746029/WI-Eau-Claire-Farrar-equity.png)** diversity, equity, and inclusion in schools.
